channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Gaza prepares to bury 105 Palestinians killed in October 2023
item.description: The bodies of 105 Palestinians have been recovered from the rubble of a residential block destroyed by Israel.

item.title: Pakistan says 22 fighters killed in air attacks on Afghanistan
item.description: Kabul says the strikes on Kunar and Helmand provinces killed nine women and children.

item.title: UK says Iran may be linked to alleged airbase plot, drawing angry denial
item.description: Andy Burnham says UK has 'strong indications' Iran involved in alleged security incident at RAF base used by US.

item.title: Iran parades Shahed drones through capital
item.description: Crowds cheered and waved national flags as two Shahed drones were paraded through Tehran.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump hints US could strike Iran, warns time coming
item.description: Trump says the US may “blow up” Iran or strike a deal, insisting the standoff will end very soon one way or the other.

item.title: Israeli attacks across Gaza kill at least eight
item.description: Israeli attacks on residential areas across Gaza killed at least eight civilians and wounded others on Wednesday

item.title: Too early to say what motive for Dubai-Tel Aviv flight attack was, Israeli PM says
item.description: A pilot who stabbed another pilot on an Israel-bound plane is under investigation in Saudi Arabia, Benjamin Netanyahu says.

item.title: What we know about stabbing on Flydubai flight to Israel
item.description: A pilot has been arrested and is being questioned after another pilot was stabbed, officials say.

item.title: Girl has multiple surgeries to control infections after strike in Gaza
item.description: Witnesses say Raseel's tent was hit by an Israeli helicopter strike. Israel’s military says it has no record of the attack.

item.title: Flydubai passenger describes putting attacker in chokehold after cockpit stabbing
item.description: Other passengers on the Israel-bound flight described the "terrifying" moment the plane dropped.
